1: /**
2:  * Reading a normalized field off a raw Scryfall bulk-data card object,
3:  * correctly accounting for double-faced/split/adventure/flip layouts.
4:  *
5:  * @typedef {Object} ScryfallCardFace
6:  * @property {string} [name]
7:  * @property {string} [type_line]
8:  * @property {string} [oracle_text]
9:  * @property {string} [mana_cost]
10:  * @property {string} [power]
11:  * @property {string} [toughness]
12:  * @property {Record<string, string>} [image_uris]
13:  *
14:  * @typedef {Object} ScryfallBulkCard
15:  * @property {string} [layout]
16:  * @property {string} [mana_cost]
17:  * @property {string} [power]
18:  * @property {string} [toughness]
19:  * @property {Record<string, string>} [image_uris]
20:  * @property {ScryfallCardFace[]} [card_faces]
21:  */
22: 
23: /**
24:  * Layouts with two distinct physical faces, each with its own picture —
25:  * transform and modal DFC only. Split, adventure, prepare, and flip cards
26:  * all print on one physical face, so there is no second image or a
27:  * meaningfully distinct back name for any of them.
28:  */
29: const TWO_SIDED_LAYOUTS = new Set(['transform', 'modal_dfc']);
30: 
31: /**
32:  * @param {string | undefined} layout
33:  * @returns {boolean}
34:  */
35: export function isTwoSidedLayout(layout) {
36:   return layout !== undefined && TWO_SIDED_LAYOUTS.has(layout);
37: }
38: 
39: /**
40:  * A card's own value for `field`, falling back to its front face's value for
41:  * a multi-faced card. Never combines faces — mana cost, power, and toughness
42:  * are all per-face characteristics, and a modal DFC is cast as one face or
43:  * the other, never both, so joining them (e.g. "{1}{G}" and "{3}{G}{G}" into
44:  * "{1}{G} // {3}{G}{G}") would show five pips for what is really one cost.
45:  * Same front-face principle as commander eligibility (CR 712.4, see
46:  * `frontFaceCharacteristics` in `@mtg/rules`): a card outside the
47:  * battlefield is its front face only.
48:  *
49:  * @param {ScryfallBulkCard} card
50:  * @param {'mana_cost' | 'power' | 'toughness'} field
51:  * @returns {string | undefined}
52:  */
53: export function frontFaceField(card, field) {
54:   if (card[field] !== undefined) return card[field];
55:   return card.card_faces?.[0]?.[field];
56: }
57: 
58: /**
59:  * The image URI for a card's front face, at the given Scryfall image size
60:  * (e.g. 'small', 'normal', 'large'). A split/adventure/flip card has one
61:  * physical face and so a top-level `image_uris`, same as a single-faced
62:  * card; a transform/modal DFC has none, and falls back to its own front
63:  * face's picture.
64:  *
65:  * @param {ScryfallBulkCard} card
66:  * @param {string} size
67:  * @returns {string | null}
68:  */
69: export function frontImageUri(card, size) {
70:   return card.image_uris?.[size] ?? card.card_faces?.[0]?.image_uris?.[size] ?? null;
71: }
72: 
73: /**
74:  * The image URI for a card's back face, at the given size — null unless the
75:  * card is a genuinely two-sided layout (see `isTwoSidedLayout`).
76:  *
77:  * @param {ScryfallBulkCard} card
78:  * @param {string} size
79:  * @returns {string | null}
80:  */
81: export function backImageUri(card, size) {
82:   if (!isTwoSidedLayout(card.layout)) return null;
83:   return card.card_faces?.[1]?.image_uris?.[size] ?? null;
84: }
85: 
86: /**
87:  * The back face's own name — null unless the card is a genuinely two-sided
88:  * layout (see `isTwoSidedLayout`).
89:  *
90:  * @param {ScryfallBulkCard} card
91:  * @returns {string | null}
92:  */
93: export function backFaceName(card) {
94:   if (!isTwoSidedLayout(card.layout)) return null;
95:   return card.card_faces?.[1]?.name ?? null;
96: }
